instruction.text: A medium bag of pasta is 500g. A large bag contains 50% more pasta. One serving of pasta is 75g. How many servings of pasta are in a large bag?
instruction.sound: A medium bag of pasta is 500 grams. A large bag contains 50% more pasta. One serving of pasta is 75 grams. How many servings of pasta are in a large bag?

atoms.b: Therefore, there are <mat><gap>10</gap></mat> servings in a large bag of pasta.

instruction.text: Gareth is ordering 100 bottles of fizzy drink. Cola costs £1 per bottle, but he gets 10% off. Orange fizz costs £1.10 per bottle, but he gets 20% off. Which option is cheaper for Gareth?

Rowena is cooking noodles for 51 people on Friday. Small packets of noodles are 400g. Large packets are 70% bigger. One portion of noodles is 40g. How many large packets of noodles does Rowena need to feed 51 people?
instruction.sound: Rowena is cooking noodles for 51 people on Friday. Small packets of noodles are 400 grams. Large packets are 70% bigger. One portion of noodles is 40 grams. How many large packets of noodles does Rowena need to feed 51 people?

atoms.b: Therefore, Rowena needs <mat><gap>3</gap></mat> large packets to feed 51 people.

instruction.text: Layla wants to buy a bus pass for 1 year. The bus pass costs £20 per month, and she gets 20% off for the first 3 months. How much will the bus pass cost for 1 year?

atoms.b: Therefore, the total cost of Layla’s bus pass for 1 year will be £<mat><gap>228</gap></mat>.

instruction.text: Tilly brings some muffins to school for her birthday. There are 30 children in her class. Tilly guesses that 40% of her class would like blueberry muffins and 60% would like chocolate muffins. The muffins come in packs of 4. How many packs of each kind did Tilly need to buy?

atoms.b: Therefore, Tilly needed to buy <mat><gap>3</gap></mat> packs of blueberry muffins and <mat><gap>5</gap></mat> packs of chocolate muffins.

instruction.text: My teacher thinks I should aim for 80% in English. There are 8 different English tests. Each test has 93 marks. How many marks do I need to get 80%?

atoms.b: Therefore, I need a total of <mat><gap>596</gap></mat> marks to get 80%.
